## Switch this on, or nothing is ever scheduled

This is the part that watches the clock. Your agent can save a schedule
without it, and nothing will ever fire.

1. Set the toggle at the top right to **Published**.
2. Run **16 - SETUP - Scheduled Work Data** once first, if you have not.

It wakes every five minutes, takes the one job that is most overdue, and
sends it to the agent that owns it as though you had typed it in the chat.
One job per wake-up, so two things set for the same minute run five minutes
apart instead of both at once.

Anything more than six hours late is skipped and rolled on to its next
time. A laptop opened at dinner time should not set off the morning's work.

Every run costs the same as asking your agent yourself. Nothing here is
free just because you are asleep.
